chunks.title: M&G (M&G Investments / Catalyst) (M&G) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: M&G (M&G Investments / Catalyst) is a Institutional / Catalytic / Climate PE headquartered in United Kingdom. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: COP31 Business Forum Climate Finance & Investments Working Group member mobilizing institutional & private impact capital. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Institutional climate transition & M&G Catalyst (£5B purpose-led private capital mandate) investing in scalable climate innovation & resilience. Source verification: https://www.copbusiness.org/papers/COP31_WG_climate-finance-investments.pdf.

chunks.title: M&G Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: M&G (M&G Investments / Catalyst) provides the following climate financing instruments: Private Growth Equity, Impact Debt, Catalyst Climate Innovation Capital, Institutional Co-Investment. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 3,000,000 to USD 150,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Climate-Tech Startup, Growth-Stage Private Enterprise, Project SPV, Fund Manager.

chunks.title: M&G Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by M&G (M&G Investments / Catalyst): Climate-Tech Innovation, Climate Adaptation & Resilience, Circular Economy & Zero Waste, Renewable Energy, Resilient Cities & Infrastructure. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Europe, United Kingdom, Emerging Markets, Türkiye. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: M&G Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete M&G's application form: Clear commercial scalability & repeatable revenue model; Verified measurable environmental/climate impact KPIs (IMP / IRIS+); Defensible technology or data moat (e.g., AI + MRV); Strong governance & institutional reporting readiness. Explicit exclusion rules: Thermal coal; Unverified greenwashing claims. Official application portal: https://www.mandg.com/investments/institutional/en-gb/solutions/catalyst.

chunks.title: M&G Form Template: Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form
chunks.text: M&G (M&G Investments / Catalyst) uses the 'Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form' workflow governed by GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository / Impact Management Project (IMP) / IRIS+ Climate Metrics. Typical review timeline is 4–10 weeks (Pitch Screening -> Commercial & Climate DD -> IC Approval). Form sections required: 1. Venture / Asset Overview, 2. Investment Thesis, 3. Product & Execution, 4. Impact & Risk, 5. Executive Pitch.
